name: qkd_ahub_sfa-sfa-COMMIT
purpose: KV-AHUB 10-19: SAFE ahub from the face-copy native source; symmetric insertion-aware centre-fed spine (cure of the a7 routed boundary spread 88.9 ps); sfa

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_ahub_static_dw_safe_native u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/qkd_ahub_static_dw_safe_face_native_kit.v rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_nhb_tiles_bb.v rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkh_recip_leaf_bb.v && echo lint-ok

bench.name: ahub_face_m0
bench.pass_regex: ^AHUB_DW PASS mut=0 passes=7 Z_IN_STRIDE=4 zwords=680 .* FR_OFS=-7 AP_OFS=ffd9ffdaffd8ffd8

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_sfa/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_sfa/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_sfa --out {RUN}/record/views/qkd_ahub_static_dw_safe_native --macro-view physical/ref_tile/ot_nhb_zh_m5/views/ot_nhb_zh --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qkh_recip_ref/views/ot_qkh_recip_leaf > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: NEW kit (KV-AHUB 10-19, lead brief: SAFE ahub a7 from the face-copy source). (1) Source = the GEN7-fixed native face-copy netlist qkd_ahub_static_dw_safe_face_native (Codex 4b05445f7: 105 collapsed AM face identities restored as kept same-edge per-output FFs, 3,420 FF, every functional/reset load <= 24, 645 distinct boundary FFs; AP_OFS ffd9ffdaffd8ffd8 / FR_OFS -7 / Z_IN_STRIDE 4 = the actual GEN7 die binding, so no die offset change). (2) Clock (cures a7 native FAIL 2c8705059, routed boundary spread 88.9 TT): symmetric insertion-aware spine instead of the count-bisection spine whose pads chained every flop to the deepest child tap. (3) sfa Synthesis = NONE: ORFS SYNTH_NETLIST_FILES takes the face netlist as mapped (tools/qwen_kv_die/ahub_safe/kit_netlist.sh: per-load TIEHI/TIELO, port insbuf, attributes dropped; 3,420 FF / 5 children unchanged; m0 bench PASS on it), so no opt_merge can fold the kept face copies.
